lines.text: Sarah spends five hours every week reading call transcripts line by line. She still misses compliance risks, loses action items, and coaches her reps two days too late.

CallCoach-AI is the independent AI quality layer on top of WhipScribe's transcription API. Four specialized LLM agents judge every call: ComplianceAgent, TensionAgent, ClarityAgent, and ActionItemAgent.
Every issue links to the exact timestamp and quote. Click through to the moment in the recording. Overall score: 68 out of 100.
CallCoach-AI doesn't just score one call — it tracks improvement across your entire team, week over week.
Zero missed action items. Zero compliance blowback. Five hours reclaimed every week.
CallCoach-AI. Your sales calls scored. Your reps coached. Your team improved.

bgm.query: CallCoach-AI turns every sales call transcript into a structured QA score with evidence timestamps — so managers stop watching recordings and start reading the insights.
